business_summary.text: GHCL Limited is engaged in the business of manufacturing and trading of Inorganic Chemicals (mainly manufacture and sale of Soda Ash).

lab.quote: On our growth initiative, our bromine and vacuum salt projects are in their final stages, and the first leg has already been commissioned. We expect full commissioning to take place in Q1 FY27.

call_memory.quote: On our growth initiative, our bromine and vacuum salt projects are in their final stages, and the first leg has already been commissioned. We expect full commissioning to take place in Q1 FY27.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Bromine and vacuum salt projects are in their final stages, with full commissioning expected to take place in Q1 FY27.

lab.quote: In FY27, this number will be INR 120 crores approximately.

call_memory.quote: In FY27, this number will be INR 120 crores approximately.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Top line for the bromine and vacuum salt projects will be approximately INR 120 crores in FY27.

lab.quote: I said that the peak numbers will be INR 170 crores.

call_memory.quote: I said that the peak numbers will be INR 170 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Peak revenue at full operational capacity for the bromine and vacuum salt projects is INR 170 crores.

lab.quote: And EBITDA range will be something around 40-45% kind of a range.

call_memory.quote: And EBITDA range will be something around 40-45% kind of a range.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: EBITDA margin range for the bromine and vacuum salt projects will be around 40-45%.

lab.quote: If you look at it in terms of the volume, there is approximately around 11% of the volume growth has happened, whereas your pricing has gone down by 10%.

call_memory.quote: If you look at it in terms of the volume, there is approximately around 11% of the volume growth has happened, whereas your pricing has gone down by 10%.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Volume growth was approximately 11% while pricing went down by 10% in Q4 FY26.

lab.quote: Almost around I would say 80%, 85% kind of a utilization we have been able to achieve in the sodium bicarbonate.

call_memory.quote: Almost around I would say 80%, 85% kind of a utilization we have been able to achieve in the sodium bicarbonate.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Sodium bicarbonate utilisation was able to achieve around 80% to 85%.

lab.quote: During the year, we distributed INR 415 crores to our shareholders in the form of dividends and buyback, which represents a substantial 87% of full year FY26 PAT.

call_memory.quote: During the year, we distributed INR 415 crores to our shareholders in the form of dividends and buyback, which represents a substantial 87% of full year FY26 PAT.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Total payout to shareholders in FY26 amounted to INR 415 crores which represents 87% of full year FY26 PAT.

lab.quote: Adding a new layer of complexity, the conflict between the US and Iran has introduced a meaningful uncertainty into global energy and raw material markets. We are seeing the effect of resulting in higher energy and input costs and elevated shipping expenses, with supply chain disruptions.

call_memory.quote: Adding a new layer of complexity, the conflict between the US and Iran has introduced a meaningful uncertainty into global energy and raw material markets. We are seeing the effect of resulting in higher energy and input costs and elevated shipping expenses, with supply chain disruptions.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The conflict between the US and Iran has introduced uncertainty, resulting in higher energy and input costs and elevated shipping expenses with supply chain disruptions.

lab.quote: Like I mentioned in the earlier quarters as well, I think some land acquisitions are kind of taking a longer time. So, at this point of time, very specifically it will be difficult to say when we are starting the construction.

call_memory.quote: Like I mentioned in the earlier quarters as well, I think some land acquisitions are kind of taking a longer time. So, at this point of time, very specifically it will be difficult to say when we are starting the construction.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Land acquisitions for the Greenfield Soda Ash project are taking a longer time, and specific construction start timeline cannot be stated yet.

lab.quote: However, debt will always be very well within the limit because we have clearly articulated to our investors that our debt-equity ratio will never cross one.

call_memory.quote: However, debt will always be very well within the limit because we have clearly articulated to our investors that our debt-equity ratio will never cross one.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Debt-equity ratio will never cross one for funding the Greenfield project.

lab.quote: I would say that the energy prices which is more of a coal on the index, it has gone up from $120 to roughly around $136, approximately I am giving the number which is a very volatile number.

call_memory.quote: I would say that the energy prices which is more of a coal on the index, it has gone up from $120 to roughly around $136, approximately I am giving the number which is a very volatile number.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Energy prices for coal on the index have gone up from $120 to roughly around $136.

lab.quote: As you rightly said, in terms of one of the US facility has been kind of a mothball, okay, which is roughly 1.3 million tons.

call_memory.quote: As you rightly said, in terms of one of the US facility has been kind of a mothball, okay, which is roughly 1.3 million tons.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: One of the US soda ash facilities has been mothballed, which is roughly 1.3 million tons.

lab.quote: Domestic Soda ash demand to grow @ 6% CAGR from FY25-30

call_memory.quote: Domestic Soda ash demand to grow @ 6% CAGR from FY25-30
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Domestic soda ash demand is projected to grow at 6% CAGR from FY25-30.

lab.quote: Bromine: Capacity of 2,800 MT at existing salt works; to generate 40%+ EBITDA margin (To commission in Q1 FY27)

call_memory.quote: Bromine: Capacity of 2,800 MT at existing salt works; to generate 40%+ EBITDA margin (To commission in Q1 FY27)
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Bromine project capacity is 2,800 MT at existing salt works, to commission in Q1 FY27.

call_memory.quote: Bromine: Capacity of 2,800 MT at existing salt works; to generate 40%+ EBITDA margin
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Bromine project is expected to generate 40%+ EBITDA margin.

lab.quote: Smart CAPEX, by design – CAPEX of over Rs. 300 Crore

call_memory.quote: Smart CAPEX, by design – CAPEX of over Rs. 300 Crore
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Smart CAPEX for diversification projects is over Rs. 300 Crore.

lab.quote: Progress on our greenfield soda ash project is slow compared to our expectations.

call_memory.quote: Progress on our greenfield soda ash project is slow compared to our expectations.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Progress on greenfield soda ash project is slow compared to expectations.

lab.quote: Total Size: Rs. 300 Crore | Buyback Price: Rs. 725/share

call_memory.quote: Total Size: Rs. 300 Crore | Buyback Price: Rs. 725/share
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Buyback completed in FY26 totaled Rs. 300 Crore at Rs. 725 per share.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Total payout to shareholders in FY26 amounted to Rs. 415 crore which is 87% of FY26 PAT.

lab.quote: 30% Reduction In Scope 1 & 2 by 2030

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: GHCL targets 30% reduction in Scope 1 & 2 emissions by 2030.

call_points.text: Domestic soda ash demand remains healthy supported by solar glass capacity additions, offsetting soft global realisations.
Commercial production of vacuum salt commenced in August 2026 and bromine in October 2026.
call_points.versus_prior: Delivered on Q1 FY27 commissioning timeline

call_points.text: Bromine and vacuum salt projects are in final stages, expecting full commissioning in Q1 FY27 with ₹120 Cr revenue contribution in FY27.
call_points.versus_prior: Reiterated commissioning timeline from Q1 FY27 guidance in previous call

call_points.text: Domestic soda ash demand remains healthy, driven by solar glass capacity additions, while imports have slowed due to higher freight costs.
Bromine and vacuum salt projects are in advanced stages and scheduled for commissioning in Q1 FY27.
Domestic demand remains healthy with stable-to-improving realizations offsetting global headwinds.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹790.51 Cr (+1.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹115.64 Cr (-23.0% YoY).
GHCL reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹808 Cr and announced advanced progress on its bromine and vacuum salt projects.
GHCL announced Q4 and FY26 standalone financial results, reporting Q4 revenue of ₹808 Cr and annual PAT of ₹479 Cr.
GHCL Limited uploaded audio recording of its Investors’ Conference on May 5, 2026, available at www.ghcl.co.in.
GHCL hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 5, 2026, highlighting the upcoming commissioning of bromine and vacuum salt projects in Q1 FY27.
Altar Investment Pvt. Ltd., via Director Vinay Dilghor (DIN:09434492), declared no new encumbrances on GHCL shares as of April 04, 2026, beyond prior disclosures.
Anurag Dalmia, GHCL’s promoter, declared no new encumbrances on equity shares as of March 31, 2026, listing 25 promoters/PACs.
Anurag Dalmia (HUF) declared no new encumbrances on GHCL Limited shares as of April 4, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Dear Investments Private Limited, as promoter of GHCL Limited, declares no new encumbrances on equity shares held as of April 04, 2026, beyond prior disclosures.
Ilac Investment Pvt. Ltd. declared no encumbrance on GHCL Limited’s equity shares as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Lakshmi Vishnu Investment Limited, via Narender Pal (Authorised Signatory/Director), declared no new encumbrances on GHCL Limited shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) as of April 03, 2026.
Pashupatinath Commercial Pvt. Ltd. (Anjul Kashyap, Director) declares no additional share acquisition in GHCL Limited beyond March 31, 2026.
Trishul Commercial Pvt. Ltd. (Anjul Kashyap, Director) declares no new encumbrances on GHCL Limited shares as of April 3, 2026, beyond prior disclosures.
GHCL filed its 43rd Integrated Annual Report for FY26, reporting consolidated revenue of ₹3,064.21 Cr and net profit of ₹472.46 Cr with clean audit opinions.
GHCL dispatched notices for its 43rd Annual General Meeting scheduled for June 25, 2026, to unregistered shareholders.
Neelabh Dalmia, GHCL Limited promoter, declared no new encumbrances on equity shares as of April 4, 2026, beyond prior disclosures.

Ricklunsford Trade & Industrial Investment Limited, via Director Vinay Kumar Mehta (DIN:00441642), disclosed no new promoter shareholding changes under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for GHCL Limited as of April 04, 2026.
GHCL approved an additional capital budget of ₹88.09 Cr for FY27.
GHCL reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹821 Cr and net profit of ₹127 Cr, while commencing commercial production of vacuum salt and bromine.
